description: Single source of truth for base-level allowed shell commands (#1880). Backend-owned: embedded at compile time by src-tauri/src/console/settings.rs, and the planner prose in data/planner/process.md + data/stages/permissions.json is drift-guarded against THIS file. The tiers are scaled by a session's bash posture: 'deny' gets mandatory only, 'ask' gets mandatory + readonly, 'allow' gets mandatory + readonly + build. 'mandatory' (gh/git/bsc) is always allowed — the app's GitHub/plan workflow depends on it. Written as explicit Bash(<cmd> *) rules at launch because Claude Code does NOT honor a bare Bash allow as allow-all.
